headline: Hanwha Ocean Secures 364 Billion Won Order for Two Very Large Crude Carriers
summary: South Korean shipbuilder Hanwha Ocean signed a 364.2 billion won ($260 million) order to construct two Very Large Crude Carriers for an Oceania-based client. The order brings its 2026 total contract volume to 47 vessels worth $8.54 billion.
why: Hanwha Ocean is one of South Korea's primary shipbuilders, specializing in commercial tankers, gas carriers, and high-value marine vessels.

impacts.name: Hanwha Ocean
impacts.why: Hanwha Ocean expanded its vessel orderbook with a 364 billion won VLCC shipbuilding deal.
